services.name: Full Day Charter
services.desc: Full days of Kona fishing are undoubtedly the best choice for those who want to maximize their chances of encountering a big blue marlin! About Duration - 9 Hour Private Charter Every day on the water is different with constantly changing currents, tides, and other variables. Being out on the water with more time lets us get a feel for the conditions. More time on the water helps us be in the right spot at the right time to maximize our angler’s chance at encountering the fish of a lifetime. Breakfast and lunch will be provided.
